collections.title: Golf Gloves
collections.description:
Bogey Bros Golf Gloves – Because Grip is the Only Thing You Can Control

Let’s be real—your swing is a disaster, your approach shots are unpredictable, and your putting? Let’s not even go there. But at least with these gloves, your grip won’t be the problem.

Designed for maximum feel and durability, our gloves make sure the only thing slipping away is your lead on the back nine. Made for weekend warriors, range heroes, and anyone who believes looking good is half the battle.

✅ Premium fit – Because we believe in second chances, not second-rate gear.

✅ Serious grip – Your drives still might be wild, but at least you’ll hold onto the club.

✅ Style that slaps – Even if your shots don’t.

They won’t fix your game, but they will make you feel like you know what you’re doing. And honestly, that’s all that matters.

Play Bad. Look Good. Grip Tight.

collections.title: Hats | Performance Golf Hat - Stretch Fit
collections.description:
Some hats look good on the shelf. These are built to live on your head.

Our Stretch Fit Hats are made for long rounds, hot days, and the kind of golf where you’re walking, swinging, sweating, and maybe talking a little trash along the way. No snaps. No adjustments. Just a dialed-in fit that feels right from the first wear.

The fabric has enough stretch to move with you through every swing, while staying breathable when the sun is doing its thing. The look is clean, easy, and unmistakably Bogey Bros. It works on the course, at the range, or wherever you end up after the round.

What makes them a go-to:
• Stretch fit design that feels natural and secure
• Lightweight performance fabric that stays comfortable all day
• Breathable construction for warm weather rounds
• Easy, low-profile style that pairs with anything
• Built for golfers who play hard and keep it fun

Pick your best. Throw it on. Let’s play.

image.alt: A text only image that spells out Stretch Fit Hats in large bold letters on a green background.

collections.title: Hats | Unstructured Flat Bill - Snapback
collections.description:
Not every round calls for stiff and proper. Sometimes you just want a hat that feels broken in from day one and looks like you’ve been wearing it for years.

Our Unstructured Flat Bill Hats bring that relaxed, easy feel with a modern edge. Soft crown, flat brim, and a laid-back shape that sits just right without feeling bulky or forced. It’s the kind of hat you grab without thinking, whether you’re heading to the course, the range, or out after a late afternoon loop.

Simple, comfortable, and built with the same Bogey Bros attitude. Show up ready to play, or at least look like you could.

Why they belong in your rotation:
• Unstructured crown for a relaxed, broken-in feel
• Flat bill profile with a clean, confident look
• Lightweight materials that stay comfortable all day
• Easy style that works on or off the course
• Made for golfers who don’t take themselves too seriously

Throw it on and let the day unfold.
